t_advice_summary_textbox.text: It is mostly random but they avoided blue and yellow gnomes. They said to go with different heights and you will work out which gnomes give you more mushrooms. I should also use breaks to stay refreshed.

vb_textbox.text: I avoided the gnome wih the tall brown hat and the gnome with the tall pink hat. I found when gnomes are on different sides they are worth different points. I found the green gnome with the short hat to be worth many points. Try and find a pattern and make sure to use the breaks and remember to press the space bar!
